games.name: [♦️] The Morgue Shift
games.desc:
⚠️ WARNING: SENSITIVE CONTENT
This experience contains flashing lights, loud noises, and unpredictable jumpscares that may not be suitable for players with photosensitive epilepsy or heart conditions.

Welcome to Harapan Kasih Hospital.
The sun has set, and you’re the only one left in the morgue. As a night shift attendant, your job is to tend to those who no longer have a voice. But in this room, silence is the loudest sound of all.

Experience the Horror:

● 60+ Unique Encounters: Everybody has a story—and a specific set of needs. (More arriving in future updates!)
● 14 Normal & 4 Secret Endings: Your choices determine how the night ends. (More endings in future updates!)
● Solo or Co-op: Designed solo for the most immersive psychological experience. but supports up to 6 players for those too afraid to face the dark alone.

The clock is ticking. Can you survive the shift?

🔨 Developed by: UltraDemetra123
